what_it_is: Chinese-language catalogue of permanently-free LLM API channels, keyed by channel with a model index
useful_for_this_pass: Has the only explicit Stealth-model section and lists Space Bunny among its 10 stealth entries. Useful as a cross-check that the model the probe found anonymously reachable is a catalogued free-tier entry rather than a misparse.
what_it_does_not_solve: States price and channel, never whether an anonymous caller can reach it. Its scope rule excludes web chat, which is the right rule and still leaves the access question open.
verified_how: Read the English README in full; counted its rows and its stealth entries

what_it_is: 131 AI tools with a hand-verified free-tier limit, each carrying a source and a check date
useful_for_this_pass: The strongest discipline in the set: every record carries a source URL and a check date, and it distinguishes a published ceiling from a vendor that refuses to publish one. That distinction is the one this pass needed for Cursor and Z.ai Team Plan, where the honest cell is UNKNOWN rather than a number.
what_it_does_not_solve: Records are check-dated 2026-08-12 to 2026-08-13, three weeks before this pass, and the ceilings are prose in Chinese rather than a machine-readable number. Adopting them wholesale would import figures nobody re-checked in September or October.
verified_how: Read limits.json; confirmed the 131 count, the per-record source and checked fields, and the 11 categories

what_it_is: Community directory of 120+ free LLM models across 41 providers with a card-requirement label per provider
useful_for_this_pass: The only one of the four that labels per row whether a provider needs a credit card or phone verification. That is an access property rather than a price property, and it is exactly the axis the 1-of-12 probe result turns on.
what_it_does_not_solve: Card requirements are self-reported by submitters and undated per row, so they are a lead rather than a finding. free-llm.com is a live site whose content I did not independently verify against vendor pages.
verified_how: Read README.md; counted provider rows and the card/phone-verification labels

what_it_is: MCP server indexing 1500+ developer infrastructure vendors, with a generated 31-record free-LLM-API index
useful_for_this_pass: Publishes the terms a vendor replaced next to the terms that replaced them with the date, and publishes why each of its 68 AI/ML records was left out of the LLM index. The exclusion accounting is the useful part: a reader can see what a list is not claiming.
what_it_does_not_solve: Its own README states 0 of the 31 rows currently carry a replaced-terms diff, so the discipline it describes is not yet paying out in data. Its universe is dev infrastructure rather than model pricing, so it contributes no $/M.
verified_how: Read README.md and artifacts/free-llm-api-index/README.md in full; counted records and the exclusion table
